description: Multi-sensor Earth observation data cubes centred on disaster events from the EM-DAT International Disaster Database, generated within the ARCEME project (Adaptation and Resilience to Climate Extremes and Multi-hazard Events). Each cube covers a 10 × 10 km area centred on the event location and integrates: Sentinel-2 L2A (13 bands + SCL, 10 m), Sentinel-1 RTC (VV + VH, 10 m), Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (10 m resampled), and ESA WorldCover 2020 (10 m). The temporal window spans ±12 months around the event date. Cloud masking is applied using SEnSeIv2/SegFormerB2.
